body:
## Summary

Every dependency should be at its latest release (the maintainers' standing requirement, applied first in link-assistant/formal-ai#1169). `js/package.json` on `main` (checked 2026-09-29) declares **59** packages whose latest release is newer than the declared range allows or the declared minimum. Major versions behind include:

| Package | Declared | Latest |
|---|---|---|
| `ai` | ^6.0.235 | 7.0.122 |
| `@ai-sdk/openai`, `@ai-sdk/anthropic`, `@ai-sdk/google`, `@ai-sdk/azure`, `@ai-sdk/groq`, `@ai-sdk/mistral` | ^2.0.x | 4.0.x |
| `@ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock`, `@ai-sdk/google-vertex`, `@ai-sdk/xai` | ^2–3 | 5.0.x |
| `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` | ^2.0.62 | 3.0.59 |
| `@ai-sdk/mcp` | ^0.0.8 | 2.0.62 |
| `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` | ^0.5.1 | 1.5.1 |
| `@opentui/core`, `@opentui/solid` | 0.1.107 | 0.5.12 |
| `@clack/prompts` | ^0.11.0 | 1.8.1 |
| `@openrouter/ai-sdk-provider` | ^2.2.3 | 3.1.0 |
| `chokidar` | ^4.0.3 | 5.0.0 |
| `diff` | ^8.0.2 | 9.0.0 |
| `fuzzysort` | ^3.1.0 | 4.0.2 |
| `glob` | ^10.0.0 | 13.0.6 |
| `gpt-tokenizer` | ^3.4.0 | 4.0.0 |
| `vscode-jsonrpc` | ^8.2.1 | 9.0.3 |
| `eslint`, `@eslint/js` | ^9 | 10.x |
| `lint-staged` | ^16.2.6 | 17.6.0 |
| `@changesets/cli` | ^2.29.7 | 3.0.3 |
| **own packages** `command-stream` | ^0.7.1 | 1.2.0 |
| **own** `lino-objects-codec` | ^0.1.1 | 0.8.0 |
| **own** `lino-arguments` | ^0.2.5 | 0.3.0 |

Minor/patch updates are pending for the other 33 (e.g. `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.22→1.31, `@opencode-ai/sdk` 1.0.78→1.18.33, `hono` 4.10→4.13, `zod` 4.1→4.6, `web-tree-sitter` 0.25→0.27, `test-anywhere` 0.7→0.9). The Rust crate under `rust/` is covered by the same rule.

## Requirements

1. R1: update every dependency to its latest release, majors included, adapting the code (the AI SDK 6→7 and provider 2→4 migrations touch the provider layer: list each breaking change handled in the pull request).
2. R2: the three own packages move to their latest releases; anything they lack that the agent needs is filed in their repositories.
3. R3: CI job that fails when anything is behind (`npm outdated` exits 1; `cargo outdated --root-deps-only --exit-code 1` for `rust/`), unless the pin line carries an open issue URL explaining the blocker.
4. R4: release the updated package; link-assistant/hive-mind bumps its pin (link-assistant/hive-mind#2324 R1 tracks the pin). Release reliability: #318.

## How to test

`npm outdated` in `js/` prints nothing; the full test suite and the Hive Mind `--tool agent` smoke run pass on the updated version.
title: Update all dependencies to their latest releases (59 behind, incl. ai 6->7, @ai-sdk 2->4, own command-stream 0.7->1.2, lino-objects-codec 0.1->0.8) and enforce it in CI
